_comment: Copy to ~/.pi/anti-loop.config.json (all projects) or .pi/anti-loop.config.json (one repo). /anti-loop on|off persists enabled. /stuck enters user-help. The 'looks stuck' notice is notify-only: churnNotifyAfterFruitless = calls that found nothing (errors, no-match greps, empty output) with no edit; churnNotifyAfterUniqueTools = high backstop for a run that reads forever without acting. 0 disables either.
